events.title: Nika riots break out in Constantinople
events.description: Rival chariot-racing factions united against Emperor Justinian and burned much of the city. Urged by Empress Theodora not to flee, Justinian had the rising crushed, with some 30,000 killed.
events.html: Rival chariot-racing factions united against Emperor Justinian and burned much of the city. Urged by Empress Theodora not to flee, Justinian had the rising crushed, with some 30,000 killed.

events.title: Council of Troyes endorses the Knights Templar
events.description: A church council at Troyes, led by a papal legate and inspired by Bernard of Clairvaux, approved a rule for the Knights Templar. The order of warrior monks became a major force in the Crusades.
events.html: A church council at Troyes, led by a papal legate and inspired by Bernard of Clairvaux, approved a rule for the Knights Templar. The order of warrior monks became a major force in the Crusades.

events.title: Treaty of Cahuenga ends the fighting in California
events.description: Californio leader Andrés Pico and John C. Frémont signed an informal capitulation near Los Angeles. It ended hostilities in California, which Mexico ceded to the United States in 1848.
events.html: Californio leader Andrés Pico and John C. Frémont signed an informal capitulation near Los Angeles. It ended hostilities in California, which Mexico ceded to the United States in 1848.

events.title: Émile Zola publishes 'J'accuse...!'
events.description: Zola's open letter in L'Aurore accused the French army of convicting the Jewish officer Alfred Dreyfus wrongly and covering up the truth. It turned the Dreyfus affair into a national crisis.
events.html: Zola's open letter in L'Aurore accused the French army of convicting the Jewish officer Alfred Dreyfus wrongly and covering up the truth. It turned the Dreyfus affair into a national crisis.

events.title: Avezzano earthquake devastates central Italy
events.description: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Abruzzo region, killing about 30,000 people. In Avezzano itself almost all of the population perished.
events.html: A magnitude 6.7 earthquake struck the Abruzzo region, killing about 30,000 people. In Avezzano itself almost all of the population perished.

events.title: Henry Ford patents a plastic car body
events.description: Henry Ford received a patent for a car body built from plastic panels on a tubular frame, part of his experiments with materials derived from soybeans. Wartime restrictions ended the project.
events.html: Henry Ford received a patent for a car body built from plastic panels on a tubular frame, part of his experiments with materials derived from soybeans. Wartime restrictions ended the project.

events.title: Johnny Cash performs at Folsom State Prison
events.description: Johnny Cash played two shows for inmates at Folsom Prison in California, recorded for a live album. 'At Folsom Prison' revived his career and became one of the best-known albums in country music.
events.html: Johnny Cash played two shows for inmates at Folsom Prison in California, recorded for a live album. 'At Folsom Prison' revived his career and became one of the best-known albums in country music.

events.title: Soviet troops storm the Vilnius television tower
events.description: Soviet forces attacked unarmed crowds defending Lithuanian broadcasting sites in Vilnius, killing 14 civilians. The violence strengthened support for Baltic independence at home and abroad.
events.html: Soviet forces attacked unarmed crowds defending Lithuanian broadcasting sites in Vilnius, killing 14 civilians. The violence strengthened support for Baltic independence at home and abroad.
